briefings.title: Howie Liu On How To Future-Proof Your Company
briefings.tldr: The current AI revolution is a multi-layered "SaaS apocalypse" happening at 10x speed, requiring leaders to abandon traditional management techniques in favor of hands-on technical immersion and "agentic" business models where tiny teams generate billion-dollar revenues.

briefings.title: Inside Airtable’s AI Reinvention: How To Future-Proof Your Company In Rapidly Changing Times
briefings.tldr: Airtable CEO Howie Liu argues that the "SaaS-pocalypse" is an under-calculation of the current AI disruption, necessitating a shift from traditional software to "agentic" platforms where small teams (1–10 people) can build billion-dollar revenue businesses.
